product.label: The Product
product.title:
LocalMind:
AI Transcription That Respects You
product.subtitle: Our first tool in the fight for AI freedom. Professional-grade audio transcription and analysis that runs entirely on your machine.
product.feature_transcription_desc: State-of-the-art speech recognition powered by Whisper. Handles accents, noise, and multiple languages with remarkable accuracy.
product.feature_speaker_desc: Automatically identifies who's speaking. Perfect for meetings, interviews, podcasts, and any multi-person recording.
product.feature_quality_desc: AI-powered insights with Chain-of-Thought reasoning for 20-30% better accuracy. Analyzes call quality, customer service, and compliance. Customize scoring to match your needs.
product.feature_export_desc: Your data, your format. Export to PDF reports, JSON for developers, or plain text. No vendor lock-in.
product.feature_multilang_desc: Use LocalMind in your native language. Interface available in English, Russian, Spanish, Hindi, and more.

how_it_works.subtitle: No accounts. No API keys. No configuration. Just download, open, and use.

how_it_works.step3_desc: Accurate transcription and insights. Export however you want.

maria.name: Maria González
maria.quote: LocalMind's Spanish transcription is incredibly accurate. I process 10+ hours of interviews weekly without paying subscription fees. The privacy guarantee means I can discuss sensitive topics with complete confidence.

yuki.name: Dr. Yuki Tanaka
yuki.quote: HIPAA compliance was critical for our patient interview transcriptions. LocalMind processes everything locally - no data ever leaves our secure systems. The quality scoring helps ensure accuracy for medical records.

ahmed.name: Ahmed Hassan
ahmed.quote: Supporting Arabic with RTL text is rare in transcription tools. LocalMind handles it perfectly. Attorney-client privilege stays intact because audio never touches the cloud. Worth every penny - which is zero!

priya.name: Priya Sharma
priya.quote: We audit 500+ customer service calls monthly. LocalMind saves us $400/month compared to cloud services. The quality scoring with CoT reasoning helps train our agents on empathy and resolution skills.

dmitry.name: Dmitry Volkov
dmitry.quote: Protecting source identities is non-negotiable. LocalMind's offline transcription means no server logs, no data breaches, no government access requests. Finally, transcription I can trust.

sophie.name: Sophie Martin
sophie.quote: GDPR compliance is automatic when data never leaves my laptop. I transcribe client meetings, team standups, and strategy sessions - all unlimited, all free, all private. LocalMind is a game-changer.
